div.div: The first template. A job is a chain of compile then simulate. Compile is skipped on a compile-cache hit (key: source hash, lockfile hash, componentize-py version, WIT contract version), so jobs that share source and lockfile build once. A batch of N jobs runs those chains independently, each simulate task with its own seed, then a single native aggregate task reads their XML result blocks and writes a summary. A failed compile stops only its own chain. Which workflow runs the batch aggregate is an open question (#17).
